name: iris_brow
title: Iris Brow - B4 forehead sensor strip for the Iris robot head: VL53L1X ToF, APDS-9306 light, two ICS-43434 I2S mics 108 mm apart, touch electrode
brief: Board B4 of Iris, the human-eyed robot head (Iris system spec v0.1, section 4.3). A 116 x 12 mm, 2-layer, 1.6 mm strip behind the forehead shell: its F face looks out through the shell at X = +22.0 in the head frame. It carries a VL53L1X time-of-flight sensor on the centre line (distance to the face in front, for vergence), an APDS-9306-065 ambient light sensor above it, two TDK ICS-43434 bottom-port I2S microphones at exactly +-54 mm (sound direction; the robot-left one answers in the left I2S slot, the robot-right one in the right slot) and a two-wing copper touch electrode for the ESP32-S3's TOUCH14. Everything reaches the Cortex board (B1) over one JST SH 8-pin harness, J1, pinned exactly as the spec's BROW contract: 3V3, GND, I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL, I2S_BCLK, I2S_WS, I2S_MIC_SD, TOUCH. Four M2 holes on the shell bosses at the binding positions. The layout is mirror-symmetric about the centre line.

blocks.title: MIC L, robot left, Y +54 (ICS-43434, LR low: left slot)

netClasses.why: Espressif: touch traces no wider than 0.18 mm and 0.5-1 mm from ground. The clearance stops at 0.35 mm because J1's pads 7 and 8 are 0.40 mm apart (1.0 mm pitch, 0.6 mm pads), and KiCad checks the class clearance between them

rules.why_min_track: the TOUCH class is 0.15 mm; 0.12 leaves room for Freerouting's rounding and is above JLC's 2-layer 0.10 mm

board.notes: Brief frame: x right, y down, seen from F (the face side). Head frame (Iris spec 4.3): X_H = +22.0 at the F face, Y_H = x - 58, Z_H = 56 - y. The outline is a brow: a parabola from y 0 at the centre to y 1.0 at the ends on top, and from y 12 to y 10.0 underneath, filleted (1000 mm and 600 mm on the shallow vertices, 2 mm at the four ends), inside the spec's binding 116 x 12 mm envelope and symmetric about x = 58. F face (out, toward the shell): VL53L1X centred at (58, 6), APDS-9306 at (58, 1.9), the two 10 x 5 mm touch wings centred at x 44 and 72, their decoupling. B face (into the head): J1 centred at the top edge with its mouth up, the two microphones (ports at x 4 and 112, y 6; the 0.5 mm NPTH opens on F). 2 layers, GND poured on both faces after routing; nothing but the wings' own TOUCH copper within 1.5 mm of a wing on F, and no copper at all under a wing on B.

tof:U?.why: on the centre line (Y_H 0, Z_H 50): the spec's 'VL53L1X at x 55.5-60.5 (centre)'; emitter at x 56.48, receiver at x 59.48 (ST outline, rotated into KiCad's footprint frame)

tof:C1?.why: 100 nF beside AVDDVCSEL (pin 1), its 3V3 pad toward the pin (ST: as close as possible)

tof:C2?.why: 4.7 uF beside AVDD (pin 11), 3V3 pad toward the pin

tof:R?.why: XSHUT pull-up beside pin 5, mirroring C1 about the centre line

link:C?.why: 3V3 bulk beside the ToF, mirroring C2 about the centre line

als:U?.why: on the centre line above the ToF (Z_H 54.1); active area at y 2.12

als:C?.why: 1 uF at the VDD pin (pin 3, lower left), 3V3 pad down

touch:TP1?.why: right wing (robot right, Y_H -14), 10 x 5 mm; inside the spec's 40-52 touch zone

touch:TP2?.why: left wing (robot left, Y_H +14), the mirror of TP1

link:J?.why: J1 centred on the B face, mouth up (+Z_H) 0.73 mm inside the top edge, pin 1 at x 54.5 and pin 8 (TOUCH) at x 61.5; mounting pads 0.58 mm from the edge. On the bottom face rot 0 is the footprint mirrored top-to-bottom (the SDK's convention), which points the mouth at -y

mic_r:MK?.why: MIC R: sound port (the footprint's 0.5 mm NPTH, 0.71 mm from its origin) at x 4.0, y 6.0 = Y_H -54.0, Z_H 50.0 exactly, outboard of the pads, so the pads face the rest of the board. Bottom port: the part is on B and the hole opens on F

mic_r:C?.why: 100 nF above MIC R: its 3V3 pad 1.2 mm from the VDD pad, its GND pad 1 mm above the port's GND ring (MIC R's LR is 3V3, so the ring has no other GND neighbour)

mic_r:R?.why: 33 ohm inboard of MIC R's SD pad (x 6.07, y 6.0)

mic_l:MK?.why: MIC L: sound port at x 112.0, y 6.0 = Y_H +54.0, Z_H 50.0 exactly, outboard of the pads (MIC R turned 180 degrees)

mic_l:C?.why: 100 nF below MIC L: 3V3 pad toward the VDD pad (x 109.93, y 6.9), GND pad toward the port's GND ring (MIC R's arrangement turned 180 degrees)

mic_l:R?.why: 33 ohm inboard of MIC L's SD pad (x 109.93, y 6.0)

route.why: every part is locked; the outline is stated and shaped, so it is never grown

silk.title_why: four short lines, about 12 mm wide and 6 mm tall, so the block fits the bare B-side box behind a touch wing (37.5-50.5 or 65.5-78.5 by 0-7.75): J1 holds the centre of the B face
silk.words_why: TOF and ALS are listed but find no spot: the 1.3 mm between the two sensors is under a 0.8 mm word's 1.47 mm text box, and caps or vias hold their other sides (measured 2026-10-03). The microphones keep their designators MK1 (MIC L) and MK2 (MIC R): 'MIC R' found no spot (C5 above, its own footprint silk below), so neither gets a word
